component.name: llm-mem MCP Server
component.summary: Standalone MCP memory server with embedded vector store

description.p: llm-mem is a standalone Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents persistent, searchable memory. It runs entirely locally with an embedded vector store (LanceDB), supports both API and local LLM backends (llama.cpp), and bundles local embeddings (fastembed). The AppImage bundles the C++ runtime statically and targets glibc 2.28, so it runs on Ubuntu 20.04+, Debian 11+, RHEL 9+, Fedora, Arch, and other modern Linux distributions without any further system libraries.
